Only DATA lives here. Signature verification and payload parsing are

Templates use {{name}} placeholders; a value of null means 'stay silent'.

echo.$comment: Room events a group may see. Anything not listed is internal-only. `commander_receipt` is deliberately ABSENT: a WeCom response_code is single-use (one inbound = one send), so a group gets exactly one message per inbound. The receipt would spend it and the real answer would fail with 60140 'invalid response code' (2026-11-19). The in-app room still shows the receipt — it streams over SSE and has no such limit. Re-add it here only for channels that can send more than one message per inbound (e.g. a group webhook).

$comment: What the GROUP reads for an event row that has no content of its own.
Never an internal event name: a customer group must not learn our
vocabulary. Missing key → the generic fallback below.

events.all_passed: 本轮无人作答——在座的席位都判断没有需要补充的内容。你可以 @ 某一位点名提问，或把问题说得更具体些。
events.reply_cap_hit: 已达本轮应答上限，其余席位保持静默。

commander_receipt.$comment: Two phases share this event: 'thinking' fires the instant routing starts, the dispatch receipt names who is on it.
commander_receipt.thinking: 已收到，正在确认由谁处理…

events.commander_none: 本轮无人作答——在场的席位都判断没有需要补充的内容。你可以 @ 某一位点名提问，或把问题说得更具体些。

$comment: How an outbound recipient is routed to an API. Pure data: adding a
platform adds an entry here, not a branch in business code.
'groupPattern' is a JS regex source; a chatKey matching it is a GROUP
(groupApi + groupField), anything else is a MEMBER (memberApi + memberField).

timeouts.$comment: Milliseconds. Overridable per deployment without an image.
